top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.33(c)(1)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Staff and volunteers obtain documentation showing immunization with 2 doses measles/mumps, 1 dose rubella, 2 doses varicella and 1 dose Tdap. Medical exemptions only. History of measles, mumps or rubella shall Not replace MMR vaccine except in presence of MMR varicella antibodies.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.61(e)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Child care service fails to store dry goods in insect/rodent proof containers at time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.33(b)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection it was determined that child care service allows staff to perform their duties that are Not healthy or are incapable of carrying out their duties. Staff medical clearances are Not maintained by child care service.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.49(a)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection child care service facility observed Not maintained or in disrepair. Dry sweeping observed in areas occupied by children.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §43.14(a)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Teaching and supervisory staff trained in abuse/maltreatment identification and reporting. 2 hours of training received every 24 months. Training provided by OCFS approved trainer. New staff trained within 3 months of hire

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §43.11(c)(1)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Each staff member has documentation showing they received 2 doses measles/mumps vaccine, 1 dose rubella vaccine, 2 doses varicella vaccine and 1 dose Tdap

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.45(b)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection child care service failed to provide sufficient lighting and or failed to maintain adequate foot candles in areas used by children.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §43.14(b)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Teaching and supervisory staff trained in infection control, reporting of infectious diseases, administration of medication, handling/storage of hazardous materials, general safety, and transportation. New staff trained within 3 months of hire
